A Clearer Path
to a Working Door.

Helpful starting points for an unexpected fault, a planned repair, or your next door.

Know What to Ask.
Choose with Confidence.

Share what has changed, review the scope, and choose a practical next step with your local team.

Request an Estimate
Start with the symptom

Describe when the door stops, the sound you hear, and whether it sits level. A technician can use that information to plan the assessment.

Keep safety systems working

Do not bypass the photo-eyes or force a door with suspected spring or cable damage. Keep people away from an unstable opening.

Understand the estimate

Ask which parts and labour are included, what other work is recommended, and which terms apply to the repair. Xpress prices depend on your system and the work required.

Compare repair and replacement

Consider the panels, hardware condition, repeated faults, and your plans for the property. Ask for the reasoning behind both options.

Plan a new installation

Discuss opening dimensions, headroom, insulation needs, finish, and operator compatibility. Specialty configurations depend on product availability and a site assessment.

After service

Ask what was checked, how to care for the system, and which warranty terms apply. Keep the written job details for future reference.

A little clarity.
A lot of confidence.

Do you offer same-day service?

Yes. Same-day appointments are available, including evenings and weekends. Call us to confirm the earliest available window for your location.

How much will my repair cost?

It depends on the door, the problem and the parts needed. We inspect first, explain your options, and give you a clear price before work begins.

Do you work on commercial doors and gates?

Yes. We repair and install commercial overhead doors, rolling steel doors, storefront security gates and operators.

Which brands do you service?

We service and install products from Craftsman, LiftMaster, Amarr, Wayne Dalton, Clopay and Hormann. Contact us about your specific system.
